quests.title: Leather Armor
quests.desc:
&7Leather Armor&r is the worst Armor set you can get. 

That is mostly because &c&lMojang&r expected you to get it before any other. 

I almost never get it though because I struggle to find that many &8C&fo&8w&fs&r, sorry &c&lMojang&r!

quests.title: Chainmail Armor
quests.desc: &8Chainmail Armor&r is a little worse than Iron. Its main use in &l&2Minecraft&r was its elusive nature, only being obtained through Trades and Mob Drops. \n\nOf course this is modded though, so we can craft it now! Which takes away its purpose...

quests.title: Golden Armor
quests.desc: &eGolden Armor&r is right between Iron and &7Leather&r. But its Durability is much closer to &7Leather&r. \n\nThere is not much use for it besides having Piglins Neutral towards you when wearing some &eGold Armor&r.

quests.title: Залізний шолом
quests.desc: Now this is what I like! Iron is very common and its Armor is incredible for early game. \n\nZombies and Skeletons stand just about no chance!

quests.title: Diamond Armor
quests.desc: &bDiamond Armor&r is the next on the &l&2Vanilla&r chain, this is also usually where we start Enchanting it as well! \n\nI recommend Protection and its various forms, we don't have to be picky with modded!

quests.title: Netherite Armor
quests.desc: &cNetherite Armor&r is the best &l&2Vanilla&r can get. It has same Armor Points as &bDiamond&r but more Armor Toughness. \n\nProbably because you need &bDiamond&r to make it!

quests.title: Усемодієві обладунки
quests.desc:
What you think &l&2Vanilla&r was all we got? 

&6Усемодієві обладунки&r has more Armor Points and Armor Toughness, plus increased Protection against Magic and other buffs you can read about in &6&lAllthemodium&r Quest Page! 

BTW you will need &cNetherite&r to craft it.

quests.title: Вібранієві обладунки
quests.desc: Much higher stats in everything with the next in line for &6&lAllthemodium&r Armors, &3Vibranium&r! \n\nYou will need &6Усемодієві обладунки&r to create it.

quests.title: Unobtainium Armor
quests.desc:
The greatest Armor we can get from &6&lAllthemodium&r, &5Unobtainium&r! 

Now with 100% Knockback Resistance and higher stats everywhere! 

Also needs &3Vibranium Armor&r to make it.

quests.title: Allthemodium Arcanist Gear
quests.desc: &6Усемодієві обладунки&r but with buffs to &d&lArs Nouveau&r Spells!

quests.title: Allthemodium Mage Outfit
quests.desc: &6Усемодієві обладунки&r but with buffs to &e&lIron's Spells&r Spells!

quests.title: Vibranium Arcanist Gear
quests.desc: &3Vibranium Armor&r but with buffs to &d&lArs Nouveau&r Spells!

quests.title: Vibranium Mage Outfit
quests.desc: &3Vibranium Armor&r but with buffs to &e&lIron's Spells&r Spells!

quests.title: Unobtainium Arcanist Gear
quests.desc: &5Unobtainium Armor&r but with buffs to &d&lArs Nouveau&r Spells!

quests.title: Unobtainium Mage Outfit
quests.desc: &5Unobtainium Armor&r but with buffs to &e&lIron's Spells&r Spells!

quests.title: Neptunium Armor
quests.desc: &3Neptunium&r is a reward from Neptune's Bounty which is gotten through Fishing! \nIt also grants buffs to being Underwater.

quests.title: Warden Armor
quests.desc: Why upgrade &cNetherite&r to &6Allthemodium&r or even anything else when we can upgrade it to &3Warden Armor&r! \n\nYou'll need a few Warden Drops in order to make it though!

quests.title: Aethersent Armor
quests.desc: &5Aethersent Ore&r is found during Meteorite Showers in &5&lEternal Starlight&r. Small ones break on impact, you'll need to wait for big Meteors! \n\nOr is it Meteorites? What's the difference?

quests.title: Thermal Springstone Armor
quests.desc: &cThermal Springstone&r spawns in hot ponds found rarely in &5&lEternal Starlight&r!

quests.title: Glacite Armor
quests.desc: &bGlacite&r is found in the cold biomes of &5&lEternal Starlight&r!

quests.title: Swamp Silver Armor
quests.desc: &9Swamp Silver&r is found within the muddy swamps of &5&lEternal Starlight&r.

quests.title: Wandering Magician Gear
quests.desc: &7Leather Armor&r just with a little Arcane sprinkled over it. \n\nGives boosts to Mana for Spells, just a little bit.

quests.title: Scarecrow Outfit
quests.desc: Very simple and cheap &e&lIron's Spells&r Armor, helpful for early game!

quests.title: Netherite Battlemage Outfit
quests.desc: Wait so you're telling me it has the same stats as &cNetherite&r? Plus Spell Boosts? And doesn't need Smithing Templates to craft? \n\nWhy would anyone want regular &cNetherite&r!

quests.title: Ferricore Amor
quests.desc: &bFerricore&r has same stats as Iron but has other abilities Iron wishes it had! \n\nCheck out the Item descriptions to learn more of what they can do!

quests.title: Blazegold Armor
quests.desc: &cBlazegold&r has same stats as Iron but has other abilities Iron wishes it had! \n\nCheck out the Item descriptions to learn more of what they can do!

quests.title: Bronze Armor
quests.desc: &6Bronze&r is a combination of &6Copper&r and Tin. \n\nThere is a dozen different ways to make the alloy, I won't tell you the right way to do so.

quests.title: Lapis Lazuli Armor
quests.desc: Thanks to &5&lMekanism&r we can now make Armor out of &9Lapis Lazuli&r! \n\nIt kinda blows though...

quests.title: Osmium Armor
quests.desc: &7Osmium&r spawns around Deepslate and only needs Iron to Mine but it gives better stats than &cNetherite&r!

quests.title: Refined Obsidian Armor
quests.desc:
By infusing Obsidian with &bDiamonds&r we can get Refined Obsidian Dust! 

Then, we can compress &7Osmium&r into it to get it in Ingot form. 

After that, we can turn those Ingots into Armor with better stats than even &6Усемодієві обладунки&r!

quests.title: Steel Armor
quests.desc: &7Steel&r is used for most Machines in &5&lMekanism&r... plus Armor which is nice!

quests.title: Quantum Armor (MI)
quests.desc:
Quite literally invincible, nothing can hit you and do damage. 

Currently you need to upgrade &cNetherite Armor&r with a &eQuantum &bUpgrade&r but your friends in the &6&lATM Team&r are working at making that recipe harder! 

And you can't do anything to stop it! &lBWAHAHAHAHA

quests.title: Inferium Armor
quests.desc: With &bDiamond Armor&r and a few &aInferium Items&r we can craft &aInferium Armor&r! \n\nThey can also be upgraded with Tinkering!

quests.title: Awakened Supremium Armor
quests.desc: You'll need to use an Awakening Ritual to get the Items to do another Awakening Ritual on &4Supremium Armor&r. \n\nI think it is worth it; it's the best Armor you can get from &2&lMystical&r!

quests.title: Compressed Iron Armor
quests.desc: This armor set has same Armor Points as Iron but is better in both Toughness and Knockback Resistance.

quests.title: Pneumatic Armor
quests.desc: "I am Compressed Iron Man!" \n\nIt can be used and upgraded with compressed Air!

quests.title: Sylvan Gear
quests.desc: Basic Armor added by &a&lRoots Classic&r, you'll need a Ritual to get it though!

quests.title: Bee Armor 2
quests.desc: This ones not any different, why are you checking it?

quests.title: Bee Armor 1
quests.desc: Checkout the &6&lBumblezone&r Quest Page to learn more!

quests.title: Cloggrum Armor
quests.desc: &7Cloggrum&r is the Iron Ore of &2&lUndergarden&r. It spawns everywhere.

quests.title: Froststeel Armor
quests.desc: &9Froststeel&r is a common Ore in the Cold Biomes of the &2&lUndergarden&r.

quests.title: MekaSuit
quests.sub: As much Energy you can supply
quests.desc:
With a ton of super expensive &l&5Mekanism&r Items you can upgrade &5Unobtainium Armor&r to the &aMekaSuit&r! 

Now it can hold Energy and instead of taking hearts from damage, it will take Energy. 

You can use Upgrade Units to make it even better!

quests.title: Basic Armor
quests.desc:
Armor is a very important part of &l&2Minecraft&r, it is what protects you from harm. 

Different pieces of Armor give different Armor Points. These are what determine the effectiveness for your Armor, the more the merrier!

Most armor can be changed for more decoration with Armor Trims, use a piece of Armor with an Armor Trim, and an Item for coloring to change the look!

quests.title: AllRightsReserved
quests.desc:
Цей квест був створений &6командою AllTheMods&r або &2учасником спільноти&r для використання у збірках AllTheMods.

Оскільки всі збірки &6AllTheMods&r ліцензовані як &eВсі права захищено&r, цей квест не дозволяється використовувати у жодних публічних збірках, які не випущені командою &6AllTheMods Team&r без явного дозволу.

Цей квест навмисно прихований, якщо ви його бачите — ви перебуваєте в режимі редагування.

quests.title: Ironwood Armor
quests.desc:
By combining some Liveroot, an Iron Ingot, and a &eGold Nugget&r you can craft &7Ironwood&r! 

Sounds like you'll need an Axe and a Pickaxe to get some. 

All of the &7Ironwood Armor&r come with a level of Protection for free!

quests.title: Steeleaf Armor
quests.desc: &2Steeleaf&r is, technically an Ingot, found within Chests in &9&lThe Twilight Forest&r. \nEach part of the Armor gives a different Enchantment!

quests.title: Knightmetal Armor
quests.desc:
These are not a fun one to get. 

You'll need &aKnightmetal Ingots&r which are obtained from Smelting &aArmor Shard Clusters&r. 

You get &aArmor Shard Clusters&r from combining 9 &aArmor Shards&r. 

&aArmor Shards&r are dropped from the &l&9Twilight Forest&r Goblins and rarely from Helmet Crabs.

quests.title: Fiery Armor
quests.desc:
If you've somehow slain the Hydra or Ur-Ghast, then you'll have access to &4Fiery Tears/Blood&r, either work! 

Now you can make &4Fiery Armor&r, by upgrading your Iron Armor with either of the &4Fiery Vials&r. 

Now your Armor is stronger than &cNetherite&r and anyone unfortunate to hit you will be set ablaze!

quests.title: Arctic Gear
quests.desc:
Arctic Gear is made with Arctic Fur. Arctic Fur is dropped from Winter Wolves and Yetis! 

No, you can't shear either of them. 

The Gear can be dyed like &7Leather Armor&r!

quests.title: Yeti Outfit
quests.desc: The &9Yeti Outfit&r needs Alpha Yeti Fur, which you guessed it! Only drops from Alpha Yetis. \n\nAtleast the Outfit will slow down your Enemies by chilling them!

quests.title: Quantum Armor (AE2)
quests.sub: As much Energy you can supply
quests.desc:
You think &5&lMekanism&r and &l&7Modern Industrialization&r can have all the fun? 

This &5Quantum Armor&r has default stats similar to &cNetherite Armor&r but, like the &aMekaSuit&r it can use Energy as a shield. 
It also has upgrades which can be installed to make you even more powerful! Like Flight, Night Vision, and even the ability to recharge. 

But the best part is that it can Linked to your Storage System! Then, you can automatically take Energy out from it and take out any Item from it no where you are.
